_comment: #457. One entry per task-creation site (xTaskCreate* incl. Static/WithCaps, pd::createTaskPreferPsram, std::thread/jthread) in src/ and main/; task_stack_gate.py fails when a file's site count differs from its entry count. 'entry' is a regex over the call-graph function name, and the worst match is budgeted. 'line' is a reference only. entry=null marks a site that is counted but not walked. 'variants' lists the esp_main files whose image links a row's code, when that is not every image; other images skip the row. 'only' names a Kconfig build feature (heap_trace) the site is compiled in; the entry is walked only when the gate gets --with <feature>, and must then be found.
_frame_allowlist: substring of a function's name -> reason. It lifts only the per-frame checks (ceiling, dynamic frame, library callee with no frame); the frame still counts in every chain budget. Bytes are Xtensa, from the #457 run on #685 @ ebdc919.

_library_defaults: regex over a library callee's name -> bytes charged when the .ci has no frame for it. A reachable library callee with no frame, no match here and no frame_allowlist entry fails the gate. A row for a runtime hook GCC labels with a use site of ours states its reason in _library_defaults_reasons.

_library_defaults_reasons.^void _ZTH5errno\\(\\)$: 0 B: GCC's TLS init hook for errno. Our objects reference it weak (nm: 'w _ZTH5errno' in libmain.a) and nothing defines it (not the toolchain's libc.a, not any IDF build archive), so it links to 0 and the TLS wrapper never calls it. It reads as ours only because GCC labels a callee it never saw defined with a use site.
_library_defaults_reasons.^int __cxa_guard_acquire\\(long long int: 1376 B, charged, not ignored: ESP-IDF's function-local-static guard (components/cxx/cxx_guards.cpp:113), labelled with a use site of ours. 1376 B is its worst direct chain over the IDF build's own .ci files (s3-eth leg, IDF v6.0.1): a first use creates the guard semaphore (static_init_prepare -> xQueueCreateCountingSemaphore -> xQueueGenericCreate -> heap_caps_malloc ...).
_library_defaults_reasons.^void __cxa_guard_(release|abort)\\(long: 752 B, charged: the same component (cxx_guards.cpp:170, :192); worst direct chain 752 B (signal_waiting_tasks -> xQueueGenericSend -> ... -> __assert_func).

_recursion_allowlist: desmo 2026-10-02: any cycle reachable from a walked task fails unless it has a row here. Key: a substring of one member's demangled name (a row names one cycle, a cycle takes one row). depth: the most live activations any one member can have, derived from a constant in the code and shown in reason. The cycle is charged depth x the sum of its members' frames, once, in every chain through it. A test (test_checked_in_recursion_bounds_follow_the_code) recomputes the derivations from JsonReader.hpp, PoolConfig.hpp and partitions.csv, so raising one of those constants fails it until the row is re-derived. Frames and members are from the Xtensa eth image, main 4e56650.

JsonReader::detail::Parser::parseObject(.reason: JsonReader::detail::Parser: parseValue -> parseValueInner -> parseArray/parseObject -> parseValue (JsonReader.hpp, struct Parser). parseValue() increments depth first and refuses past kMaxDepth = 8 (JsonReader.hpp:35, :269), so at most 8 nested parseValue frames do work and a 9th is refused on entry: at most 9 live activations of any one member. Input over kMaxBytes = 16384 is refused before parsing (:377). Called only by the config-import handler (HttpServer.cpp:5512, :5542), on http_conn. Frames 32 + 32 + 112 + 144 B.

JsonReader::Value::~Value().reason: The destructor loop of the tree the parser above builds: ~Value -> ~vector<Value> or ~vector<pair<string,Value>> -> ~pair -> ~Value (members arrVal and objVal of struct Value). A Value tree is built only by that parser (HttpServer.cpp:5512, :5542), whose nesting stops at kMaxDepth = 8 (JsonReader.hpp:269) with, at worst, one empty element left by the refused 9th level: at most 9 live ~Value activations. Frames 32 B each; the D1 alias nodes cost 0.

_KeyOfValue = std::_Identity.reason: std::set<std::string> keep, six of them in sendApiConfigImport (HttpServer.cpp:5622, :5641, :5664, :5676, :5688, :5706), filled from arrays of the import blob. The blob is refused above JsonReader::kMaxBytes = 16384 B (JsonReader.hpp:40, :377) and an array entry costs at least 4 B (a one-character string and its comma), so n <= 4096. A red-black tree of n nodes is at most 2*log2(n+1) = 24.0 levels tall and _M_erase recurses once per level (it loops down the other spine). Frame 32 B.

_Val = std::pair<const std::__cxx11::bas.reason: SipSecretStore.cpp ha1Cache() (:99; ESP builds only, hostMap() at :67 is host-only): one HA1 string per secured extension. An entry is cached only after its NVS key was committed (:235) or read back (:326), so n is at most the number of items the nvs partition can hold: 0x6000 B = 24576 B (partitions.csv, partitions_4mb.csv) at one 32 B NVS entry minimum per item, n <= 768. A red-black tree of n nodes is at most 2*log2(n+1) = 19.1 levels tall and _M_erase recurses once per level. Reached from the reset paths (:391, :400), on http_conn. Frame 32 B.

std::pair<const std::__cxx11::basic_stri.reason: RequestsHandler::_sessions (RequestsHandler.hpp:2329). Every _sessions.emplace in RequestsHandler.cpp (and insertSession, RequestsHandler.hpp:998) follows an allocateSession() draw from _sessionPool, which holds POCKETDIAL_MAX_SESSIONS Sessions (RequestsHandler.cpp:239-243; PoolConfig.hpp:43 default 8; main/CMakeLists.txt:266 sets 4 for the constrained profile), so n <= 8. A red-black tree of n nodes is at most 2*log2(n+1) = 6.3 levels tall and _M_erase recurses once per level. Frame 32 B.
